# Shyena

> Autonomous quality engineering for AI systems and enterprise software.

Shyena helps engineering teams understand AI systems, test realistic agent behaviour, secure trust boundaries and produce evidence-backed release decisions.

## Products

- [Nexus](https://www.shyena.eu/nexus): understand agent logic, orchestration, dependencies and test coverage.
- [Vera](https://www.shyena.eu/vera): test and evaluate conversational and agentic AI journeys.
- [Chakra](https://www.shyena.eu/chakra): secure agentic AI systems with adversarial testing and evidence.
- [CIS](https://www.shyena.eu/cis): deterministic system intelligence and test-generation foundations.

## Platform assurance lifecycle

Understand → Test → Evaluate → Secure → Prove.

Every release signal should be traceable to the underlying execution, conversation, finding, affected component and evidence.
